objectives: Memahami dan memakai advanced conditionals dalam kalimat dan teks berbahasa Inggris.
Menerapkan materi melalui contoh dan latihan singkat.
Memeriksa jawaban dan memperbaiki kesalahan umum.

blocks.text: Mixed conditionals menghubungkan kondisi masa lalu dengan akibat sekarang, dan inversi kondisional dapat menghilangkan if dalam gaya formal.
If + past perfect, would + base form (akibat kini); Had + subject + V3, ... = If + subject + had + V3.
If she had saved the file, she would have a copy now.
blocks.note: Mixed — Kondisi lampau memengaruhi keadaan saat ini.

blocks.text: Had I known, I would have called.
blocks.note: Inversion — Setara dengan If I had known, ...

blocks.incorrect: Had I knew, I would call.
blocks.correct: Had I known, I would have called.
blocks.explanation: Inversi bentuk lampau sempurna: had + subject + V3.

blocks.text: Strategi latihan: baca seluruh kalimat, tandai petunjuk waktu atau hubungan makna, lalu pilih bentuk yang paling tepat. Setelah menjawab, jelaskan alasannya dengan kata-katamu sendiri.

practice.prompt: If he had practised, he ___ more confident now.
practice.explanation: Akibat kini dari syarat lampau: would + V1.

choices: Had we left earlier, we would have arrived on time.
Had we leave earlier, we arrive on time.
If had we left earlier, we would arrive.
practice.explanation: Had + subject + V3 dengan hasil past conditional.

practice.prompt: If she had caught the bus, she ___ here now.
practice.explanation: Mixed conditional hasil saat ini: would be.
